cards.ex: We wandered off the trail and got completely lost in the woods.
cards.exUz: Biz yo'ldan adashib, butunlay o'rmonda adashib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan yo'nalishdan tashqariga chiqib ketmoq, adashmoq.

cards.ex: My aunt's a real culture vulture, she's always at museums and concerts.
cards.exUz: Xolam haqiqiy madaniyat ixlosmandi, u doim muzey va konsertlarda.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyatga qiziquvchi, ko'p madaniy tadbirlarga boradigan odam.

cards.ex: Some travelers sleep rough to save money on accommodation.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi sayohatchilar turar joyga pul tejash uchun ko'chada tunashadi.
cards.uzDef: Uysiz odamlar kabi ko'chada, boshpanasiz tunash.

cards.ex: We're planning a city break to Rome next month.
cards.exUz: Kelasi oy Rimga shaharga qisqa sayohatni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Shaharga qisqa muddatli sayohat, odatda dam olish kunlarida.

cards.ex: I like to roam around the old town and discover new places.
cards.exUz: Men eski shaharni daydib yurishni va yangi joylarni kashf qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadsiz ravishda bir joydan ikkinchi joyga sayr qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to catch the train.
cards.exUz: Agar poyezdga ulgurmoqchi bo'lsak, tezlashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish, shoshilmoq.

cards.ex: They're in Vegas, living it up at the casinos.
cards.exUz: Ular Vegasda, kazinolarda maza qilib dam olishyapti.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizga yoqqan narsalar bilan vaqt o'tkazish, ko'p pul sarflash.

cards.ex: The island is so remote, it's practically off the map.
cards.exUz: Orol shunchalik olisda joylashganki, deyarli xaritada yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Juda olis va kam odam boradigan joy, noma'lum hudud.

cards.ex: He's an armchair traveler, he loves watching documentaries about different countries.
cards.exUz: U uydan sayohat qiluvchi, turli mamlakatlar haqidagi hujjatli filmlarni tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Televizor, kitoblar orqali sayohat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Let's take the scenic route, it'll be more enjoyable.
cards.exUz: Keling, manzarali yo'ldan yuraylik, bu yanada yoqimliroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zal manzaralardan bahramand bo'lish uchun uzoqroq yo'ldan yurmoq.

cards.ex: After living there for a year, she started to go native.
cards.exUz: U yerda bir yil yashagandan keyin, u mahalliy hayotga moslasha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyning urf-odatlari va turmush tarziga moslashmoq.

cards.ex: Their house is in the middle of nowhere, miles from the nearest town.
cards.exUz: Ularning uyi hech qayerning o'rtasida, eng yaqin shahardan uzoqda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda olis, aholisiz joyda.

cards.ex: The holiday was a welcome break after a stressful year.
cards.exUz: Ta'til stressli yildan so'ng kutib olingan dam olish edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan va yoqimli dam olish.

cards.ex: Make sure you get your fill of the local delicacies while you're here.
cards.exUz: Bu yerda ekanligingizda mahalliy taomlardan to'yguningizcha yeganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan yetarli miqdorda bahramand bo'lmoq, to'ygunicha yemoq.

cards.ex: We should make the most of the sunshine while it lasts.
cards.exUz: Quyosh bor ekan, undan maksimal darajada foydalanib qolishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan eng yaxshi tarzda foydalanish.

cards.ex: Traffic was moving at a snail's pace due to the accident.
cards.exUz: Yuz bergan baxtsiz hodisa tufayli transport harakati ilon izi bilan harakatlanayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin harakatlanish.

cards.ex: We were flying by the seat of our pants, but we managed to finish the project.
cards.exUz: Biz rejalashtirmasdan, tajribamizga asoslanib harakat qildik, lekin loyihani tugatishga muvaffaq bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirmasdan, tajribaga asoslanib harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: As soon as we arrived at the hotel, we made a beeline for the pool.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxonaga kelganimiz zahoti, to'g'ri hovuzga yo'l oldik.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyga to'g'ri va tez yo'l olmoq.

cards.ex: He wants to save money so he can see the world.
cards.exUz: U dunyoni kezish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
cards.uzDef: Turli mamlakatlar va joylarni ziyorat qilish.

cards.ex: We decided to go off the beaten path and explore some smaller villages.
cards.exUz: Biz mashhur yo'ldan chetga chiqib, kichikroq qishloqlarni o'rganishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Kam odam boradigan joylarni ziyorat qilish.

cards.ex: This restaurant is a local hotspot, you should try it.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran mahalliy mashhur joy, siz uni sinab ko'rishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy aholi yaxshi ko'radigan mashhur joy.

cards.ex: Moving to the countryside was a welcome change of pace.
cards.exUz: Qishloqqa ko'chib o'tish hayot tarzining kutilgan o'zgarishi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik hayotdan farqli, yangi tajriba.

cards.ex: I got the travel bug after my first trip abroad.
cards.exUz: Chet elga birinchi sayohatimdan keyin men sayohat ishqibozi bo'lib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qattiq qiziqib qolmoq, ishqibozi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Even when camping, I like to have a few creature comforts.
cards.exUz: Hatto lagerda ham, men bir nechta qulayliklarga ega bo'lishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Hayotni qulay qiladigan narsalar, masalan, yaxshi yotoq, issiq suv.

cards.ex: We lived like kings on our honeymoon in the Maldives.
cards.exUz: Biz Maldiv orollaridagi asal oyimizda shohona hayot kechirdik.
cards.uzDef: Juda hashamatli, qulay va dabdabali hayot kechirmoq.

cards.ex: The hotel was pretty run-of-the-mill, nothing special.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona juda oddiy edi, hech qanday o'ziga xos narsa yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, o'ziga xos bo'lmagan, ko'p uchraydigan.

cards.ex: As soon as we got to the airport, we made a beeline for the duty-free shop.
cards.exUz: Aeroportga kelganimiz zahoti, biz boj olinmaydigan do'konga to'g'ri yo'l oldik.
cards.uzDef: Tezda va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri biror joyga borish.

cards.ex: I get itchy feet if I stay in one place for too long.
cards.exUz: Agar men bir joyda juda uzoq qolsam, menda sayohatga ishtiyoq paydo bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilishni xohlash, yangi joylarni ko'rishga ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: This guesthouse is like a home away from home.
cards.exUz: Bu mehmonxona xuddi o'z uyidek.
cards.uzDef: Uydagidek qulay va tanish joy.

cards.ex: They spent their vacation in the lap of luxury at a five-star resort.
cards.exUz: Ular ta'tilni besh yulduzli kurortda hashamat ichida o'tkazdilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda qulay va hashamatli sharoitda.
